Altron, Inc. is seeking a Software Engineer to join its Navy Programs team supporting mission-critical software systems for U.S. Navy platforms. The role focuses on developing, integrating, testing, packaging, and maintaining secure C++ software applications for submarine combat systems in an agile environment.
Finance
Crowdfunding
Financial Services
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Designing, developing, and maintaining C++ applications supporting U.S. Navy submarine combat systems
Building and packaging software applications as containers for deployment to a Kubernetes-based runtime environment, working with senior engineers on configuration and deployment
Developing unit tests for software components and supporting test coverage as features evolve
Executing components and integration testing in lab environments troubleshooting defects identified during test
Collaborating with product leads and test engineers to understand requirements, resolve issues and deliver software within an agile development environment
Producing clear, maintainable, well-documented code that follows program coding and configuration management standards

Required
The ideal candidate will bring experience in C++ development on Linux, including modern C++ (C++11 and newer), unit testing, and sound software engineering practices
The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret Clearance
U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret clearance at time of hire
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, plus 1–3 years of professional software development experience using one or more of the following languages: Java, C++11 (or newer), or Python
Working knowledge of C++11 or newer and fundamental software engineering practices
Familiarity with Git-based version control and code review workflows
Familiarity with Linux based development environments
Familiarity with agile software development methodologies and collaborative team environments
Ability to communicate effectively within technical teams and customer environments
Preferred
Experience developing/working in a Linux environment, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
Experience containerizing applications with Docker or Podman
Familiarity with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test and deployment workflows
Scripting experience in Python or bash
Ability to learn new technologies and take on increasing responsibilities
Experience working within a small agile team environment
